release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.9.0 Release — Special App Access & Background Pop-up Guidance:
• High-Craft Interactive Tutorial: Triple-tabbed visual walkthrough covering (1) Special App Access (Standard Android / HyperOS), (2) Xiaomi MIUI / HyperOS 'Other Permissions' (Display pop-up windows while running in background), and (3) Vivo / Oppo / Realme floating window settings.
• 1-Click System Navigation: Dedicated buttons to jump directly into Special App Access (Appear on Top), Xiaomi Other Permissions editor, and App Info.
• Settings Integration: Access the full background permission guide anytime from Student Settings.
